<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<body>
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App;

#[Attribute]
final class Greeter
{
    public function __construct(private readonly string $name = 'world') {}

    public function greet(int $times): string
    {
        // line comment
        # hash comment
        /* block comment */
        $text = "Hello, $this->name! {$times}x ${times}\n\x41";
        $raw = 'single \'quoted\' $notvar';
        $doc = <<<EOT
            Heredoc with $name
            EOT;
        $now = <<<'NOW'
        Nowdoc $plain
        NOW;
        return str_repeat($text, $times) . $raw . $doc . $now;
    }
}

$g = new Greeter();
echo $g->greet(2), PHP_EOL, NULL ?? TRUE, 0x1F + 1_000 + 1.5e3;
?>
<p>Total: <?= count([1, 2, 3]) ?></p>
</body>
</html>
